answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using Proof of Space-Time. Each agent seals unique, non-deduplicable data bound to its public key and answers random epoch audits with succinct proofs of sustained storage. Attackers incur the capital and energy cost of dedicated drives and copper interconnects per identity instead of branching like a vine on one host. However, hyperscalers holding a vast lagoon of idle disk capacity can still mint cheap Sybils.
